mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns following a sustained 3-month decline in FEDFUNDS are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.3 percentage points above 4.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 110 and an increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.5% indicates a broad-based economic contraction, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns following the joint condition INDPRO<110 and UNRATE>4.5 are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During active monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and CPIAUCSL annual inflation rate > 3.5%), the S&P 500 experiences negative returns over the next 5 trading days due to reduced liquidity and risk appetite.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns during the regime (FEDFUNDS>4.5% and CPIAUCSL>3.5%) are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over the prior 3 months signals robust consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns following a sustained 3-month increase in HOUST are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 110 in the prior month signals a contraction in manufacturing output, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns following INDPRO < 110 are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in GDP (GDPC1) below 11300 and a drop in housing starts (HOUST) below 1900 thousand units signals a severe demand contraction, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns following the joint condition GDPC1<11300 and HOUST<1900 are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the CPI index above 200 (relative to 1982-1984 base) signals accelerating inflation, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days due to real rate pressure.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns following CPIAUCSL > 200 are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.
